title: Krishna Again
author: Gopikrishnan Kottoor
text:
You sat beside me,
The moon slipping mercury
Upon your naked breasts.
Such a moon, such shining,
That I ain`t seen before.
That was my first time.
You were dense.
We talked not of battlefields
Left to conquer.
The tapioca green was wild around us.
We just held hands.
It was then,
That you suddenly took me whole.
Just a few feet away from us
Was Krishna,
With all those flower pots around him
Bursting to bloom.
I remember,
With these hands
I had Him painted all silver.
Fluteless, Radhaless, he kept watching us
As we turned the night
into Vrindavan.
